data.body: **[P1] Preserve fatal errors from operation-thread hooks.** These throws do not always reach `DurableExecutor`: step/child handlers catch `Throwable` and may checkpoint a user-function or nested-operation hook fatal as an ordinary failure, while checkpoint batching catches fatals from operation-end/change hooks and only fails request futures. Route these causes through the execution failure future and bypass operation retry/serialization and batcher containment; add executor-level coverage for user-function and checkpoint-driven hooks.
